recruitment_scheduled_at_check.name: recruitment_scheduled_at_check

outbox_retry_bounds_check.name: outbox_retry_bounds_check
outbox_retry_bounds_check.value: retry_count >= 0 AND max_retries >= 1 AND retry_count <= max_retries

notification_pref_email_forbidden_check.name: notification_pref_email_forbidden_check
notification_pref_email_forbidden_check.value: (notification_type IN ('DM', 'MENTION', 'JOIN_REQUEST', 'JOIN_REQUEST_RESULT') AND email = false) OR (notification_type IN ('FRIEND_INVITE', 'ROOM_INVITE', 'TEAM_INVITE', 'REMINDER_10MIN'))

report_target_shape_check.name: report_target_shape_check
report_target_shape_check.value: (target_type = 'USER' AND reported_user_id IS NOT NULL AND reported_message_id IS NULL AND target_id = reported_user_id) OR (target_type = 'MESSAGE' AND reported_message_id IS NOT NULL AND reported_user_id IS NULL AND target_id = reported_message_id)

pending_image_uploads_filename_check.name: pending_image_uploads_filename_check
pending_image_uploads_filename_check.value: length("pending_image_uploads"."file_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 255 AND position('/' in "pending_image_uploads"."file_name")=0 AND position(chr(92) in "pending_image_uploads"."file_name")=0
